verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents central storage of connected-account credentials (OAuth/key-based auth) and a Connect API keyed by external_user_id for managing end-user accounts, which implies some centralized credential management. However there is no evidence of team-sharing controls or granular permissions over who can use which credential. Missing for 10: team/role-based access control for credentials, sharing settings across ops team members, and any audit/governance UI for credential permissions.
